name: ml-l-shared
comment: 6A's last measurement: profile L beside 48 unit S tenants on one launch cell (k = 8), L admitted with byte weight 7 (k - 1, the most a project may hold: edge #196), whose append ceiling (1,802,500 B/s) is below the profile's ~1.82 MB/s, and at 1.70 req/s the bucket would run at 97% load, so L runs at 1.40 req/s here (about 80%) (its cost scaled to the profile by produced bytes); against pack-s-mux-0048 alone the same day for L's marginal.

classes.comment: Profile L, large sink (section 4.1): 1,000 x 1 KiB JSON records per request at 1.4 req/s over 50 streams (the profile is 1.78 req/s, 150 GiB/day), no live readers, one catch-up walk from the earliest offset of every stream at 1,260 s (the run's 'day'); oracle-corpus records.
